records.aiReason: The prediction paper reports 21 injury labels and an ambiguous total of 927 training sessions, while separately stating that each constructed dataset contained 954 data. It does not report participant count, player-hours, athlete-exposures, match-exposures, a study-specific time rate, or explicitly establish that each session/row is one player-session in the complete at-risk frame. The session count cannot be assumed to be an athlete-exposure.
records.aiEvidenceQuote: A total of 927 training sessions were recorded over a 23-week period

safeguards.criteriaClarification: Session, match, dataset-row, sample, or observation counts are not athlete-exposures without an explicit one-athlete-per-participation mapping and a complete unconditioned at-risk frame.
